purpose: Route files exporting a mutating verb (POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE) that resolve no request viewer. Each one was a write nobody could attribute. This list may only shrink, and it is now EMPTY — so the check is a plain ratchet: any new mutating route that resolves no viewer fails preflight immediately, and the correct response is never to add it back here. Resolve the viewer and pass it to a service that fails closed without one. Session-creation endpoints are exempt in the check itself, not listed here, because they can never be repaid. See .brain/reviews/pm-triage-2026-08-17.md §S1 and §S5. History: 26 recorded 2026-08-17 → 23 when FR-065 repaid the three /api/import/* routes → 4 when FR-072 repaid nineteen → 2 when FR-073 gave Repository an owning Business → 0 when FR-074 and FR-075 named the two authorities the last two routes needed. The last two were never repayable by writing a better guard: /api/scope and /api/backup/import each waited on an owner decision about who may hold authority above a Business. Those reasons are kept in .brain/waves/route-viewer-plan.md §BLOCKED as the record of what a refusal to invent authority looked like while it stood.
